title: Kazakh–Dzungar War (1723–1730)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Kazakh–Dzungar War (1723–1730)", at revision 1382107279, opens: "The Kazakh–Dzungar War of 1723–1730 was the most significant conflict of the Kazakh–Dzungar Wars between the Kazakh Khanate and the invading Dzungar Khanate from 1723 to 1730." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q138545403, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of Kazakh–Dzungar Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
